name: mwangaza-wetu
description: Mwangaza Wetu - Monorepo pour backend et frontend

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@mwangaza/backend' build && bun run --filter '@mwangaza/frontend' build
scripts.lint: bun run --filter '@mwangaza/backend' lint && bun run --filter '@mwangaza/frontend' lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --filter '@mwangaza/backend' lint:fix && bun run --filter '@mwangaza/frontend' lint:fix
scripts.clean: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force backend/node_modules, backend/dist, frontend/node_modules, frontend/.next, node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
scripts.prisma:generate: cd backend && bun run prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && bun run prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:studio: cd backend && bun run prisma studio
